info.name: LazyScan
info.description:
LazyScan API — self-upload manga reader.

Business routes are versioned under `/api/v1` (set `base_url`). Ops endpoints (`/health`, `/metrics`) live at the root (`root_url`); `/metrics` is internal-only.

Auth is cookie-based: Login / Verify Email set the `session` HTTP-only cookie, which Postman stores in its cookie jar automatically.

Synced from the codebase routes (handlers under `api/src/modules/*`). The worker services (image-svc `/convert` + `/health`, mail-svc `/health`) are internal to the docker network and not host-exposed by default.
